about.label: ABOUT US
about.subtitle: Your Trusted Travel Companion
about.paragraph1Html: At Hej Ceylon, we don't just plan trips—we create memories that last a lifetime!
about.paragraph2Html: We are a Sri Lanka & Sweden-based travel service, built on trust, care, and an unshakable commitment to hospitality, customer satisfaction, and safety. Whether you're exploring breathtaking landscapes or diving into rich culture, we ensure a seamless, secure, and heartfelt travel experience.
about.paragraph3Html: Let us take you beyond the ordinary—because your journey matters!

tours.label: Explore Sri Lanka
tours.description: We offer <1>seven</1> extraordinary travel categories, each carefully curated to bring you the best of Sri Lanka. Whether you seek cultural heritage, thrilling adventures, or a luxury retreat, we've got you covered!
tours.fallbackDescription: Discover the beauty of Sri Lanka with this exclusive tour package.

destinations.label: Reach Your Dream Destination
destinations.descriptionHtml: Imagine standing atop a misty mountain, strolling through ancient ruins, or feeling the ocean breeze on a golden beach. With us, you don't just travel—you experience Sri Lanka like never before.
